summary: The agent implements a solid baseline pipeline using CatBoost and LightGBM models, handling both categorical and text features adequately. However, the solution suffers from cross-validation leakage by fitting transformers on the entire training set before the CV splits, completely fails to report any validation metrics, and relies on an arbitrary, untuned blending strategy for ensembling.
